title: Private beta: pay by card, one device at a time, the Character studio grows, a new feel
notes:
- Pay by card: plans can now be paid by card as well as with PayPal. Checkout and card management run on Stripe's own secure pages - AI Portal never sees your card. Billing shows how your plan is paid, a card plan has Manage card & invoices, and receipts say how you paid
- One device at a time: an account runs on one computer at a time. Sign in on another one and AI Portal says the account is in use on another device - choose Use this device instead and the other one signs out at its next check
- Private Beta is EUR 120 a month, flat; Standard EUR 25, flat - the usage fee is gone. Your plan is confirmed by a signed answer from our server, so the first start of this version needs an internet connection; afterwards a week offline works as before
- Character studio: the video cast sheet picks any look for a video; pins keep the candidates you like while you regenerate the rest; new outfit views join a video-ready set; every render comes back as a fresh picture, and a Seedream picture that missed its view or framing is made again on its own
- Characters work on Seedream: the character you pick in the Character panel goes into Seedream renders too
- MAX has a second brain: the purple MAX is a stronger model for hard prompts (Private Beta only)
- A new feel: soap-bubble buttons that press like a film, glass surfaces with a bright rim, a mode pill that morphs between modes, the generation counter in glass, a softer card shadow. The music player and the Show in folder button are gone; the small folder button next to Open is purple
- Smoother: the home and navigation no longer stutter, the run clock no longer redraws the whole window ten times a second, and the app rests when it is idle
- Startup: the top-right buttons no longer show over the loading screen
- Seedance: a picture you rendered from text with Seedream 5.0 Pro or Flash (unedited, from the last 30 days) counts as your own render, so Seedance takes the people in it as a reference
- NanoBanana 2.1 takes large inputs: up to 100 MB per request (the other engines keep 20 MB)
- Fixes: dozens from the October bug hunts - the plan screen only offers the payment methods that are set up, the Spending panel's unconfirmed count has a clear button and the cost badge is compact, Stop also stops a take that is still being prepared, and more
